verdict.rationale: Evidence shows webhooks, an API/SDK, and integrations connecting Featurebase to external tools, plus embeddable widgets for putting Featurebase content into a customer's own product — but nothing about a plugin/app framework that lets developers build custom functionality that runs inside Featurebase's own interface. Missing for 10: any documented app/plugin marketplace, custom UI extension points, or SDK for embedding third-party functionality within Featurebase's own dashboard.
